en: Doronjo-sama!
It's Bokan time!
Time Bokan Series: Bokan desu yo
Theme song: Bokan to Ippatsu! Doronbow
This show's brought to you by Banpresto, y'hear.
Quit before the end and it's punishment time!
You'll lose every time, Doronbow, no matter how often you try!
As long as we're around, you'll never amount to a thing!
You're not getting any younger.
Isn't it about time you retired?
Grr! Grr! Oh, it's galling, that's what it is!
Gaaah!
Ugh, pestering me even in my dreams! What rotten brats.
Honestly! Boyacky! Boyacky!
Wh-wh-what is it, Doronjo-sama? Oh my!
When's our match with the Yatterman bunch?
I can't wait another second! We sortie right now!
Now, now, now, calm down.
Why not change first? Little ol' me doesn't know where to look!
Says the one who's ogling me!
I'm back! Went and did it, I tell ya.
Oh, Tonzra. Where'd you run off to?
Over at the Yatterman bunch's place.
You see, I sent him to deliver our challenge letters.
Delivered 'em all, I tell ya!
So that means... it's finally time?
Sorry to keep you. All preparations are complete, yes indeed.
Ah, I've been waiting for this!
Total victory this time! We'll pound 'em flat and smash 'em to bits!
Arahora-sassa!
One Yatterman, order up, eh?
What a flying start, Boyacky.
When I put in a little effort, this is what you get.
Genius, genie-us, gee, what a genius!
note: pun on three readings of 流石

en: Flatter a pig and up the tree it goes?
Squee!
No way! Really? So cute!
That's how easily we beat 'em! Oh, this is too much!
But it's goin' too well, I tell ya.
Still, don't let your guard down, you two.
Arahora-sassa!
Things are goin' great! We can do this, I tell ya!
Everything's going splendidly, Doronjo-sama.
Daikyojin, Sankan-O, Gyakuten-O...
With those three great heroes beaten, victory is surely ours!
Right! Let's flatten the rest of the good guys and make it a total victory!
Arahora-sassa!
The Yatterman duo, Zenderman, Rescueman, Yattodetaman, Ippatsuman...
...plus Itadakiman and the original Bokan too.
Looks like we've gone and beaten them all.
Hm? Meaning...?
GREAT VICTORY
It's our big win! Eat that, ya good-guy chumps!
Don't get cocky, Doronbow!
Th-that voice... it can't be!
Yatterman!
As long as evil walks this earth, justice will never die!
We'll rise again and again to punish evil!
Yatterman-1, on the scene!
And Yatterman-2!
Take that! Kendama Punch!
Ow! Doronjo-sama, why'd you dodge?!
Electric Stick!
What's this, what's this? You just lost! What do you want?
Yeah! Your precious Yatter King's in ruins, isn't it?
Silence, Doronbow! We'll teach you what real justice is!
In the name of justice, we'll do you the honor of a challenge!
If that's how you want it, you're on!
Boyacky! Tonzra!
Let's clinch this win and shut them up for good!
Arahora-sassa!
All right, just a little more, you two!
Here we go. Extra-Extra-Large Super Megaton Bomb, stand by!
Annnd... click!
Huh?
What? That's odd. Is the button broken?
Hurry up and press it!
Boyacky, this is bad! Time to scram!
What's going on? What in the world is this?! Hey!
I've got a bad feeling about this.
Have we lost again...?
We won where it counts, though.
But we're the ones in tatters, I tell ya.
I'm just... so tired.
Doronjo-sama, you mustn't lose heart!
We swore we'd go home in glory, remember?
Don't you give up!
That's right! We Doronbow are immortal, right?
That's right, Doronjo-sama! Next time we'll seize victory, you'll see!
I'll work my hardest too, I tell ya!
You two...
Doronjo-sama...
I've decided.
Decided what?
Let's go on a rampage around the world, like the old days!
Let's take on anything and make the Doronbow name ring out! How 'bout it, boys?
Of course I agree! I've been waiting all this time for you to say that, Doronjo-sama!
We're together forever, I tell ya.
Boyacky... Tonzra...
All right! Let's head home and get ready!
The Genius Doronbow are immortal!
I am Dokurobey, y'hear!
Huh? You're not a hamburger?
I was just about to eat it!
Show some respect, y'hear!
Time for an order, the first in ages!
Beat every hero of the Time Bokan series!
Whaaat!?
Pull it off and I'll make you Doronbow the true stars, y'hear!
R-really, sir?
At last, we'll make our major debut!
Maybe we'll even get in the movies!
To start, go take on Yatterman, y'hear!
I'll back you up this time.
Y'know, little ol' me's got a great voice. Maybe I'll be a singer.
And me? A top model, of course, wouldn't you say?
I'll be a Hollywood star, I tell ya!
With tomato ketchup, y'hear.
Listen when someone's talking, you numbskulls!
Got it? Then get out there, y'hear!
Go on, go on, move it!
Not bad. I'll grant you some praise, y'hear!
We're honored!
Next, flatten Zenderman and Rescueman in one go!
They may be tough, but do your best, y'hear!
Leave it to us, Dokurobey-sama!
Leave it to me, I tell ya!
How's that, Skull Bun?
Well, Doku-chan? Pretty strong, huh, little ol' us?
I'm in top shape, I tell ya!
Don't you get chummy with me, you numbskulls!
I was gonna praise you, but I've changed my mind, y'hear.
Instead I'll toughen up your spirit on the training stage!
Yaaay!
Hoo! You survived the training! So here's your reward, y'hear!
Oh, thank you! What an honor!
Doronjo-sama, it won't be anything good, I bet.
Better not be another bomb, I tell ya.
Modeled on my beeyootiful face...
...the one and only Dokurobey Car, y'hear!
Use it with care, y'hear.
Yikes, now there's a design I don't want to use.
Worse than a bomb, I tell ya.
Shh! Just act happy for now!
All right, we sortie in this new machine!
Arahora-sassa!
I am Doku-Melon... er, Dokurobey, y'hear.
Only a few good guys left now, y'hear.
You two, we're one step from our major debut!
We've got this. Victory is as good as ours.
Let's finish 'em off, nice and quick!
Well done, you bunch, y'hear.
With the heroes down, the Time Bokan series is all mine!
Then as promised, you'll make us the stars, won't you?
Don't talk nonsense, you numbskulls!
You're done here. The starring role is mine alone, y'hear!
W-w-wait a minute, Doku-chan!
That ain't the deal, I tell ya!
From next time, the show's renamed Time Dokurobey, y'hear!
Time Bokan Series: Time Dokurobey!
note: row 10 is the logo caption, drawn over row 9

en: Kiddies all over the land, I'll be expecting you, y'hear!
Can you believe this?
This is plain betrayal, Doronjo-sama!
I'm steamin' mad, I tell ya!
Right then, let's beat Doku-chan and claim the true starring role!
Have you got a way to win, Boyacky?
Nothing's impossible for this genius.
One or two Doku-chans? A piece of cake!
Yeah! We're unbeatable now, I tell ya!
All right.
Let's show 'em what happens when you anger the Doronbow!
Let's do it, Doronjo-sama!
Doronjo-sama!
You two, we're storming Dokurobey's secret base!
Arahora-sassa!
Ow, ow, ow! What a beating we took.
Honestly, we finally win, and now look at us. The mecha's wrecked too!
Fear not, Doronjo-sama! I readied a spare mecha just in case.
Annnd... click!
Voiced by composer Masayuki Yamamoto, ya know.
My long-awaited turn has come at last, ya know!
Ho ho hoo!
Hoo-hoo, owl right! Nice work tonight!
Hoo-hoo, owl right! Mom's in sight!
Here it comes! It's here!
Yahoo!
Ohhh!
Well, shall we head home?
What the?! What's this?!
Ow, ow, ow!
That hurt!
As long as Yatterman exists...
...evil shall never prosper in this world!
What?! Not again!
Some heroes! That wasn't very clean!
We were only pretending to lose before!
We knew that if you won, mastermind Dokurobey would show up!
Is that true?!
No way! That's a lie!
Sore losers, I tell ya!
It's true!
Look, Yatterwan FZ is in perfect shape!
Whaaat!?
Arooo!
Still, I never thought you'd actually beat Dokurobey.
In honor of that, we'll let you off easy this time.
Use this chance to turn over a new leaf, okay?
So long, Doronbow!
I am Dokurobey, y'hear.
Those numbskulls actually had the guts to turn on me!
I think a bit better of 'em now, I reckon.
But for the crime of defying the great me...
...they'll pay with a punishment, y'hear!
Music, start!
